triggers.name: new_contact
triggers.title: New contact created
triggers.help: Checks for new contacts added to a specific contact list every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: organization_id
input.label: Organization
input.hint: Select an organization before selecting the event. If left blank, Organization specified in the connection will be used. Organization is required, if not given in connection.

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: When you start recipe for the first time, it picks up contacts created from this specified date and time. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

input.name: contact_list
input.label: Contact list
input.hint: Select list to monitor for new contacts

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Eventbrite action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Eventbrite connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_contact
actions.title: Create/update contact
actions.description: Create or update contact in Eventbrite
actions.help: Create a contact in defined contact list. If a contact with the specified email already exists in the list, this action will delete that existing contact and create a new contact record with the newer data.

input.name: list_name
input.label: List name
input.hint: Exact, case sensitive name of contact list

input.name: email
input.label: Email
input.hint: Unique email that identifies contact within the list

actions.name: create_contact_list
actions.title: Create contact list
actions.help: Create a new contact list in Eventbrite. New list will be created even if name is duplicated.

input.name: name
input.label: Contact list name
input.hint: Name of contact list to create. New list will be created even if name is duplicated.

actions.name: get_attendees
actions.title: Get event attendees
actions.help: Retrieve a list of event attendees for an event, given an event ID. Results list is usually limited to 50 by the Eventbrite API , or fewer if the attendee record contains many custom fields. Consider using the triggers to obtain a large number of attendees.

input.name: event_id
input.label: Event ID
input.hint: Eventbrite event ID to fetch attendees.

input.name: changed_since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: When you start recipe for the first time, it picks up new/updated attendees from this specified date and time.

actions.name: search_events
actions.title: Search events
actions.help: Search for an event by event name or event ID. A list of matching events will be fetched. The maximum number of events returned is approximately 50, but may vary depending on the size of the event object.

input.name: organization_id
input.label: Organization
input.hint: Select an organization before selecting the event. If left blank, Organization specified in the connection will be used. Organization is required, if not given in connection.

input.name: event_id
input.label: Event ID
input.hint: Eventbrite event ID
